You're absolutely right, thank you for the correction. I misstated how `git stash` works:

- **`git stash`** (plain) — only stashes tracked files that are modified or deleted
- **`git stash -u`** (or `--include-untracked`) — also stashes untracked files
- **`git stash -a`** (or `--all`) — also stashes ignored files

So in your case, since your new file was untracked, `git stash` left it in the working tree. You would have needed `git stash -u` to include it. That explains why the file was still there after switching branches.
